violations.description: GitHub Actions workflows use unpinned mutable refs or mismatched versions
violations.evidence: .github/workflows/release.yml uses actions/checkout@v3 and actions/setup-python@v4 while test.yml uses checkout@v4 and setup-python@v5; release.yml also uses pypa/gh-action-pypi-publish@release/v1 (branch reference)
violations.recommendation: Pin all GitHub Actions to specific full-length commit SHAs with version tags as comments, and use consistent versions across workflows.

violations.description: Missing standard community health files (SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md)
violations.evidence: Repository lacks SECURITY.md or CONTRIBUTING.md in .github/ or root directory.
violations.recommendation: Add SECURITY.md and CONTRIBUTING.md to establish security disclosure policies and contribution guidelines.

violations.description: Release workflow checkout action uses outdated major version
Insecure HTTP URL used in project metadata
violations.evidence: pyproject.toml uses http://saythanks.io/to/example for 'Say Thanks!' URL
violations.recommendation: Use HTTPS for all project URLs in pyproject.toml.
